geo_code.description: Code that represents a geographic entity (location or object). Only returned when Vertex or Avalara for Communications is enabled.

vat_number.description: Customer's VAT number (to avoid having the VAT applied). This is only used for automatically collected invoices.

card_type.description: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, JCB, etc.

first_six.description: Credit card number's first six digits.

last_four.description: Credit card number's last four digits. Will refer to bank account if payment method is ACH.

last_two.description: The IBAN bank account's last two digits.

gateway_token.description: A token used in place of a credit card in order to perform transactions.

cc_bin_country.description: The 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the card's issuer, if known.

funding_source.description: The funding source of the card, if known.

gateway_code.description: An identifier for a specific payment gateway.

account_reference.description: Used by Adyen and Braintree gateways. For Adyen the Shopper Reference value used when the external token was created. For Braintree the PayPal PayerID is populated in the response.

gateway_attributes.description: Gateway specific attributes associated with this PaymentMethod

card_network_preference.description: Represents the card network preference associated with the billing info for dual badged cards. Must be a supported card network.

billing_agreement_id.description: Billing Agreement identifier. Only present for Amazon or Paypal payment methods.

name_on_account.description: The name associated with the bank account.

account_type.description: The bank account type. Only present for ACH payment methods.

routing_number.description: The bank account's routing number. Only present for ACH payment methods.

routing_number_bank.description: The bank name of this routing number.

username.description: Username of the associated payment method. Currently only associated with Venmo.

primary_payment_method.description: The `primary_payment_method` field is used to indicate the primary billing info on the account. The first billing info created on an account will always become primary. This payment method will be used

backup_payment_method.description: The `backup_payment_method` field is used to indicate a billing info as a backup on the account that will be tried if the initial billing info used for an invoice is declined.

token.title: Token
token.description: Reference value used when the external token was created. If a Stripe gateway or Ebanx gateway is used, this value will need to be accompanied by its reference_type.

reference_type.title: Reference Type
reference_type.description: The type of reference token. Required if token is passed in for Stripe Gateway or Ebanx UPI.

items.title: Payment Gateway References Object
items.description: Array of Payment Gateway References, each a reference to a third-party gateway object of varying types.

payment_gateway_references.description: Array of Payment Gateway References, each a reference to a third-party gateway object of varying types.

created_at.description: When the billing information was created.

updated_at.description: When the billing information was last changed.

ip.description: Customer's IP address when updating their billing information.

country.description: Country, 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code matching the origin IP address, if known by Recurly.
